B_path.accepted_accounting: actual per-site birth count; retain accepted service if a later request exhausts
B_path.claim: budget-aware outcome-informed heuristic; no guaranteed fixture cure, minimum insertion cost or all-site coverage
B_path.connected_mode: 17.2 unchanged: one request per missing-path site
B_path.deficit: minimum Euclidean distance from site forward set to output backward set; empty sets infinity
B_path.order: active sites without G_s path; current deficit ascending; ties (site-pointer) mod 8
B_path.output_first: no active strong output path: retry smallest-deficit site after acceptance; next site only on connection or finite candidate exhaustion
B_path.pointer: advance by one modulo eight at every check, including empty/blocked
B_path.resource_stop: cap/cost ends output-first service for check; later unconnected requests log same refusal with zero attempts
B_path.search: eight nearest frontier pairs x thirteen rotations per request; two accepted births total
B_path.snapshot: order and output-first mode once at check start; recompute strong graph/front/back before every request
B_path.waiting: all eight sites; eligible/unserved/current/max checks, accepted births and outcomes
B_path.waiting_units: B-path checks; inactivity pauses, acceptance or observed active connection resets

saddle_diagnostic.definition: first world endpoint with abs(unwrapped carrier-relative phase - initial phase) >= departure_radians
saddle_diagnostic.direction: sign of unwrapped displacement at first departure; not a completed 2pi winding
saddle_diagnostic.not_observed: null direction/time/bracket, status NOT_OBSERVED; horizon 16 s
saddle_diagnostic.time: first 0.1 s endpoint crossing, bracketed by previous endpoint (initial t=0 included)

comparator.effect: total effect of removing site bodies, including neighbour selection and normalization
comparator.scope: fresh final whole medium copy per episode

excursion.policy: pair-only; invalid means inactive; records retained
excursion.qualification: screen actual cohort before circular criteria

fixture_entropy.F5: reused outcome-informed engineering fixture; not independent
fixture_entropy.F7: previously NOT_RUN; dependent on reused F5; chain not fresh
fixture_entropy.exception: section 13 supersedes fresh-entropy stop for these fixtures only

output_port.budget_pairs: actual Ntheta undirected ordinary-to-ordinary pairs; O incident pairs excluded

clock.K: live signed coupling K; weighted experiment K=1
clock.degree: actual full held receiver row; recomputed after trial insertion
clock.status: provisional aligned single-edge scale; no end-to-end settling guarantee or serial bound

strong_links.formula: lambda * K * exp(-r*r) / full held receiver phase-neighbor count
strong_links.placement: unchanged r_star=0.556; progress conditional on admissible trial, clearance and budget
strong_links.root_eligibility: unchanged gain > 0, active strict site reach, ordinary unsilenced member
strong_links.selection: filter actual directed phase edges after full k-nearest selection

output_first.bootstrap: no effective root: normal demand and B1; first accepted root can defer later sites within same check; root loss resumes
output_first.controls: M exact intact accepted-B1 count/timing bypasses its own predicate; U queue unchanged
output_first.escape: none while root persists without a path; finite horizon and unchanged failure gates
output_first.frame: freeze all novelty values under predicate, including covered or pre-ready; outside predicate 8.9 unchanged
output_first.predicate: CURRENT ordinary unsilenced gain-positive effective root exists and no active site has strong path to O
output_first.request: live predicate before each B1 site request; ready active deferred_output_first terminal, zero attempts, timer retained
